relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: “Constipation” ranked second for erenumab but did not make the top ten events for fremanezumab or galcanezumab; cardiovascular events did not rank in the top ten AEs for any product.

key_findings: In FAERS during the first 6 months post-launch, migraine, headache, drug ineffective and injection-site reactions were the most reported AEs for all three CGRP mAbs; constipation ranked second for erenumab.
Serious outcomes were <=2% of AEs and cardiovascular events were not in the top ten for any CGRP mAb.
